title: Private Studio Membership
how_to_join: Contact studio directly at (608) 419-2640 or manager@thekilnshed.studio
summary: Monthly membership for private studio spaces (6x8 to 10x12) with 24/7 access, electrical outlets for wheel and tools, and access to firing at cone 10 wood and gas reduction, plus cone 6 electric.
source_quote: PRIVATE STUDIO MEMBERSHIP Starting at $400 per MONTH
evidence_sentence: The membership page indicates private studio members have access to wood and gas reduction firing.
evidence_quote: WOOD FIRED REDUCTION CONE 10 SODA REDUCTION CONE 10
